latin: Vnumquodque in natura intellectuali habet a sua intelligibili unitate et quod quodlibet sibi uniat, et quod immaculatam ac inpermixtam sibi suam seruet proprietatem.
translation: Each thing in intellectual nature has, from its intelligible unity, both that it unites everything to itself, and that it keeps its own property immaculate and unmixed.
